items.title: 68252_Jay Cee
items.q: our friends, the Greenmaryls' and Patti Morrow and Billie Butler

ctx.x: They're planning a program for J.C. -- just one for a production, a whole thing, and then they're talking with the people in Wurtsboro, and our friends, the Greenmaryls' and Patti Morrow and Billie Butler, and the people up in Monticello and then in the western part of the county, Elaine, we feel that J.C. could become a catalyst for the county honoring him, but they're doing
something good for the county, giving it a cultural emphasis, which this county so sorely needs.
